Pin a Binding (tenant × providers × credentials × policy).
Every CLI exec and MCP tool call is hard-scoped to that pin.
Sibling to Phantom Secrets: Phantom protects secrets in context;
Locus protects which identity acts.

Commands are grouped (in display order):
  Setup         init · quickstart · setup · agent · doctor · watch · workspace · hook · mcp · engagement · graph · goal · verify · upstream · adapter
  Daily use     enter · switch · pin · leave · whoami · status · exec · run · binding
  CI            ci mint · ci env · ci run
  Approvals     approve · notify
  Audit         events · forensics
  Local UI      serve · dashboard
  Maintenance   completion · topic · version

Topic help:  locus topic <name>  or  locus help topic <name>
  Topics: dashboard · forensics · serve · goal · verify · agent · mcp · http · upstream · adapter

Usage: locus [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  init        Initialize ~/.locus (or LOCUS_HOME)
  quickstart  First 60 seconds: init samples if needed, enter workspace default, whoami + doctor
  capability  Operator control-capability posture: status / persist / unpersist
  setup       Register locus-mcp with an AI client config
  doctor      Health check for the local control plane
  watch       Continuous session heartbeat for hub (verify_session each tick)
  workspace   Write a .locus.toml in the current directory
  hook        Shell hook snippet (prints eval-able code)
  mcp         Run the locus-mcp stdio server, or manage multi-tenant MCP grants
  enter       Enter a client context (pin + shell-friendly status)
  switch      One-shot switch: leave the active pin (if any) and enter ALIAS
  pin         Pin the current session to a binding
  leave       Leave the active pin (clear identity) and suggest re-enter
  engagement  Manage client engagements (init / close)
  graph       Encrypted binding-graph share (bindings + workspace templates, no secrets)
  whoami      Show who you are acting as (active pin)
  status      Short status line for prompts / CI
  agent       AI-native setup + identity readiness (setup / doctor / report)
  goal        Northstar goal progress (`GOALS.md` or embedded milestones)
  verify      Verification plane — score claims / session pack before acting (M5)
  exec        Run a command with only the pinned binding's identity surface
  run         One-shot: run a command under a temporary pin (global pin unchanged)
  binding     Manage bindings
  client      Guided client onboarding — walk through adding a client binding
  upstream    Built-in upstream MCP recipes (command/args for common servers)
  adapter     Built-in adapter registry catalog (manifest list + signature verify)
  ci          CI / ephemeral pin minting (short-lived sealed sessions)
  approve     Manage advisory review labels and blocked external authorization records
  notify      Desktop approval banners (OFF by default — opt in explicitly)
  events      Read recent local audit events (`$LOCUS_HOME/audit/events.jsonl`)
  forensics   Export a shareable forensics pack (no secrets)
  serve       Serve the local identity dashboard + JSON API (127.0.0.1 only)
  dashboard   Open the local identity dashboard (serve + browser)
  completion  Generate shell completions (bash | zsh | fish | elvish | powershell)
  topic       Extended help for product surfaces (dashboard, forensics, serve, goal, verify, …) [alias: help-topic]
  version     Print version (also available as `locus --version`)
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json
          Emit machine-readable JSON where applicable

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

  -V, --version
          Print version
